title: Making sense of a sentence
text: I was going to the shop. The speaker was on their way to the shop at a time in the past. The sentence does not tell us whether they arrived.
source: Piet Educator original demonstration • Sentence meaning • Passage 1

title: Sharing equally
text: There are twelve counters. Share them equally among three people. Each person receives four counters. Four plus four plus four equals twelve. There are no counters left over.
source: Piet Educator original demonstration • Equal groups • Passage 2
